errors.text: The proposed CALPHAD-plus-ML workflow does not reconstruct the target DFT/MTP/FEP methodology.
Evidence for predicting room-temperature elastic moduli from elemental descriptors is improperly extrapolated to corrections for melting temperature, entropy of fusion, and heat capacity.
No computational route is specified for calculating entropy of fusion or heat capacity, despite these being central requested properties.
The baseline is misidentified as conventional CALPHAD and Lennard-Jones MD rather than the target TOR-TILD approach using EAM references and thermodynamic integration.
The proposed validation against EAM/MEAM is not a reliable high-fidelity reference for refractory multicomponent liquid free energies.
